solutions.title: Count and sort
solutions.strategy: Count each word, then sort unique words by descending frequency and ascending word.

timeComplexity.explanation: Counting scans n words and sorting orders u unique words.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The frequency map and unique-word list store u entries.

solutions.title: Size-k min heap
solutions.strategy: Keep only the best k words in a heap whose root is the currently worst retained candidate.

timeComplexity.explanation: Counting scans all words and each unique word performs a heap operation bounded by k.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The frequency map stores u words and the heap stores k candidates.
